World._work_note.value:
def _work_note(self, b):
    """For buddies with work days/hours: say outright whether they're at work now.
    Small models don't reliably work out "it's Sunday, so I'm off" from the date, and
    this only sticks when it's the last thing in the system prompt."""
    slow = b.contact.slow_replies
    if not slow or (slow.days == "all" and not slow.hours):
        return ""
    day = timefmt.shifted(timefmt.local_now(b.contact.timezone)).strftime("%A")
    if self._busy_now(b):
        return f"\n\nIMPORTANT: It's {day} and you're at work right now, replying in between."
    return (f"\n\nIMPORTANT: It's {day} and you're off work right now, so you're not at "
            "work: you're at home or out doing your own thing.")

World._pictures_prompt.value:
def _pictures_prompt(self, b):
    c = b.contact
    if not c.pictures or c.picture_sharing == "never":
        return ""
    user = self.settings["screen_name"]
    sent = self._sent_pictures(b)
    lines = []
    for key, names in c.pictures.sets.items():
        count = f"{len(names)} pictures" if len(names) > 1 else "1 picture"
        seen = " (already sent)" if all(n in sent for n in names) else ""
        about = "; ".join(c.pictures.captions[n] for n in names)
        lines.append(f"- {key} ({count}){seen}: {about}")
    if c.picture_sharing == "eager" and not self._shared_recently(b):
        when = ("You like sharing these, but don't rush: you don't need to show them all, "
                "and most messages have no pictures. Offer or send a set only when the "
                "conversation turns to what it shows, or when the chat has gone quiet.")
    elif c.picture_sharing == "eager":
        when = (f"You shared pictures just recently, so don't send more unless "
                f"{user} asks.")
    else:
        when = f"Only send a set if {user} asks to see pictures."
    when += " Never send more than one set in a message."
    return ("\n\nPicture sets on your computer that you can send (sending a set sends "
            "every picture in it):\n" + "\n".join(lines) +
            f"\nTo send a set, write [pic: set name] on its own line in your message. {when} "
            "Never send a set that isn't on this list, and don't resend sets marked "
            "(already sent) unless asked.")

World.build_messages.value:
def build_messages(self, b, instruction=None):
    system = self._system_prompt(b)
    convo = self._conversation(b)
    if instruction:
        user = self.settings["screen_name"]
        convo.append({"role": "user", "content": (
            f"[Private note, not a message from {user}: {instruction} "
            f"Write only the instant message you send to {user}.]")})
    used = estimate_tokens(system) + sum(self._tokens(m) for m in convo)
    while used > self._budget() and len(convo) > 1:
        used -= self._tokens(convo.pop(0))  # oldest falls out first
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}] + convo

LifeSim.context.value:
def context(self, name):
    """What a buddy remembers: their recent journal, for any program's prompt."""
    if name not in self.buddies:
        return ""
    from .. import fursonas
    about = fursonas.knowledge(name, self.user)
    entries = self.journal.entries(name)[-CONTEXT_ENTRIES:]
    if not entries:
        return about
    lines = "\n".join(f"- {e['date']}: {e['text']}" for e in entries)
    return about + (f"\n\nYour recent diary notes, including things you talked about with {self.user} on "
                    f"AIM, IRC, the MUCK or email (use them naturally if they come up; don't recite them):"
                    f"\n{lines}")

Network._reply.value:
def _reply(self, b, instruction=None):
    if b.busy:
        return
    from ... import ai_models, llm_server
    if not llm_server.available():
        return
    b.busy = True
    self.typing_changed.emit(b.contact.id, True)
    user = self.my_handle()
    status = {ONLINE: f"{user} is online.", AWAY: f"{user} is away.", BUSY: f"{user} is busy."}.get(
        self.my_status, f"{user} is online.")
    system = PROMPT.format(name=b.name, user=user, network=self.title,
                           now=timefmt.now_text(b.contact.timezone), persona=b.contact.persona.strip(),
                           status=status, memory=self._memory(b))
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}]
    for m in b.history[-30:]:
        if m["kind"] == "user":
            msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": m["text"]})
        elif m["kind"] == "contact":
            msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m["text"]})
    if instruction:
        msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": f"[{instruction}]"})
    elif msgs[-1]["role"] != "user":
        b.busy = False
        self.typing_changed.emit(b.contact.id, False)
        return
    model = ai_models.model_for("conversation", resident=b.name)

    def done(text, err):
        reply = clean_reply(text or "", b.name) if not err else ""
        if not reply:
            b.busy = False
            self.typing_changed.emit(b.contact.id, False)
            return
        typing = min(8.0, 0.8 + len(reply) / 18)
        QTimer.singleShot(int(typing * 1000), lambda: self._deliver(b, reply))

    broker.get().chat(model, msgs, {"num_ctx": int(ai_models.config()["context"]),
                                    "temperature": b.contact.temperature}, done, broker.AIM, think=False)

DiscordNetwork._channel_reply.value:
def _channel_reply(self, ch, b, instruction=None, then=None):
    def finish():
        if then is not None:
            QTimer.singleShot(random.randint(1500, 6000), then)
    from ... import ai_models, broker, llm_server
    if b.busy or not llm_server.available():
        finish()
        return
    b.busy = True
    self.typing_in[ch.name].add(b.contact.id)
    self.channel_typing.emit(ch.name)
    user = self.my_handle()
    lines = []
    for e in ch.history[-20:]:
        if e["kind"] == "user":
            lines.append(f"{user}: {e['text']}")
        elif e["kind"] == "contact":
            other = self.buddies.get(e.get("who", ""))
            lines.append(f"{other.name if other else e.get('name', 'someone')}: {e['text']}")
    system = CHANNEL_PROMPT.format(name=b.name, channel=ch.name, server=SERVER, user=user, topic=ch.topic,
                                   now=timefmt.now_text(b.contact.timezone), persona=b.contact.persona.strip(),
                                   memory=self._memory(b), transcript="\n".join(lines) or "(nothing yet)")
    ask = instruction or f"Write your next message in #{ch.name}."
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"[{ask} If you have nothing to add, reply with just SKIP.]"}]
    model = ai_models.model_for("conversation", resident=b.name)

    def stop():
        b.busy = False
        self.typing_in[ch.name].discard(b.contact.id)
        self.channel_typing.emit(ch.name)

    def done(text, err):
        reply = clean_reply(text or "", b.name) if not err else ""
        if not reply or reply.strip().upper().startswith("SKIP"):
            stop()
            finish()
            return

        def deliver():
            stop()
            self._channel_deliver(ch, b, reply)
            finish()
        QTimer.singleShot(int(min(8.0, 0.8 + len(reply) / 18) * 1000), deliver)

    broker.get().chat(model, msgs, {"num_ctx": int(ai_models.config()["context"]),
                                    "temperature": b.contact.temperature}, done, broker.AIM, think=False)

Brain.channel_line.value:
def channel_line(self, p, chan, nudge, callback, priority=PRIORITY_CHATTER):
    others = [m for m in self.net.member_nicks(chan.name) if m.lower() != p.nick.lower()]
    extra = CHANNEL.format(channel=chan.name, topic=chan.topic, others=", ".join(others[:25]) or "nobody",
                           player=self.net.nick)
    log = "\n".join(list(chan.log)[-25:]) or "(nothing yet)"
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self._system(p, extra)},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Recent chat in {chan.name} (most recent last):\n{log}\n\n{nudge}"}]
    self._chat(p, messages, lambda text, err: callback(None if err else parse_line(text, p.nick)), priority)

Brain.query_line.value:
def query_line(self, p, history, nudge, callback):
    """history: [{'role','content'}] of the private chat so far (user = the player)."""
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self._system(p, QUERY.format(player=self.net.nick))}]
    messages += history[-30:]
    if nudge:
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": nudge})
    self._chat(p, messages, lambda text, err: callback(None if err else parse_line(text, p.nick)),
               PRIORITY_QUERY)

Brain.act.value:
def act(self, c, room, log_lines, nudge, callback, priority=0):
    """Ask c what they do in room. callback(action or None)."""
    others = [o.name for o in self.world.people_in(room.id) if o is not c]
    if self.world.player_room == room.id:
        others.append(self.world.player_name)
    extra = ACT.format(room=room.name, room_desc=room.desc, others=", ".join(others) or "nobody",
                       player=self.world.player_name)
    log = "\n".join(log_lines[-20:]) or "(nothing yet)"
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self._system(c, extra)},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"What just happened in {room.name} (most recent last):\n"
                                            f"{log}\n\n{nudge}"}]
    self.llm.chat(self._model(c, priority), messages, self._options(c),
                  lambda text, err: callback(None if err else parse_action(text, c.name)), priority, think=False)

Brain.page.value:
def page(self, c, text, callback):
    """The player paged c. callback(reply text or None)."""
    c.page_history.append({"role": "user", "content": text})
    del c.page_history[:-20]
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self._system(c, PAGE.format(player=self.world.player_name))}]
    messages += c.page_history

    def done(reply, err):
        line = None if err else _clean(reply, c.name).strip('"')
        if line and line.upper().strip(".!") != "PASS":
            c.page_history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": line})
            callback(line)
        else:
            callback(None)

    self.llm.chat(self._model(c), messages, self._options(c), done, 10, think=False)  # pages jump the queue

Brain.describe.value:
def describe(self, c, callback):
    """Write c's look description. callback(text or None)."""
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self._system(c, "")},
                {"role": "user", "content": DESCRIBE.format(name=c.name, species=c.species)}]

    def done(text, err):
        text = (text or "").strip().strip('"')
        text = re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", text)
        callback(None if err or not text else text)

    self.llm.chat(self._model(c), messages, self._options(c), done, think=False)

FurcBrain._system.value:
def _system(self, c, extra):
    from claudeaim import timefmt
    player = self.world.player_name
    aim = self.world.aim_name
    if aim and aim.lower() != player.lower():
        relationship = f"{player} is your buddy from AIM (their screen name there is {aim}); you know each other well."
    else:
        relationship = f"{player} is your AIM buddy; you know each other well."
    base = BASE.format(name=c.name, now=timefmt.now_text(c.contact.timezone if c.contact else None),
                       persona=c.persona or "(none)", species=c.species, desc=c.desc or "",
                       relationship=relationship)
    from ...life import get as life
    if c.contact is not None and life():
        base += life().context(c.contact.screen_name)
    return base + extra

PROMPT.value:
You are the World Wide Web on {date}. Given a URL, you write the complete HTML page that web server would send back, exactly as it would have looked in October 2001.

Rules:
- Output ONLY the HTML document, from <html> to </html>. No explanations, no markdown, no code fences.
- Use 2001-era HTML 3.2/4.0: <table> layouts, <font face="..." color="..." size="...">, <center>, <hr>, <b>, <i>, <ul>, and colors on <body bgcolor text link vlink>. No CSS files, no <style> blocks, no JavaScript, no forms or input boxes, no frames or iframes.
- Images: only these built-in images exist, always give width and height:
    /img/construction.gif  (animated 'under construction' sign, 100x50)
    /img/counter.gif       (hit counter, 88x20)
    /img/new.gif           (a 'NEW!' badge, 32x16)
    /img/email.gif         (a mail icon, 32x32)
    /img/line.gif          (a decorative divider line, 400x8)
    /img/button.gif?text=Some+Words      (an 88x31 web button saying those words)
    /img/photo.gif?text=what+it+shows    (a photo or picture; describe what it shows)
  Any other image shows as a broken image.
- Make it specific and believable for 2001: real-sounding names, dates, prices, 2001 events and technology (Windows XP just came out, Napster, dial-up, AIM, ICQ, Geocities-style homepages, webrings, guestbooks, 'best viewed in 800x600', Netscape vs Internet Explorer).
- Include 6 to 15 links: relative links to other pages on the same site, and full http:// links to other plausible sites. Link text should say clearly what's there.
- Keep the page between one and three screens long.
